international.title: China’s media hails Huang’s Nvidia return as it warns over ‘witch-hunts’
international.summary: State-owned media outlet says reports about CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy were ‘malicious’ Trump made up to $15m on Nvidia stock after Huang’s return Business live – latest updates Chinese media has reacted with glee to the dramatic reinstatement of Jensen Huang as the chief executive of Nvidia, with one commentary warning against future “witch-hunts”. An article published on Tuesday in the state-run outlet the Global Times said US media reports about Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset were “malicious” and “negatively impacted American public perception of China”.
